scoring_justification: CSV is audited for phase-transition signatures (Pzz drops); JSON slopes are compared to paper Table I gold values with relative tolerance (±50%) and sign match. Stronger tier (recompute slopes from CSV) is not used because the reference CSV's per-phase averages would not produce slopes within tolerance of the paper gold; a result-level comparison of the reported slopes against the paper numbers is reliable and honours the output contract metric_recompute.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Clapeyron slopes from Table I of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I, digitised from the published manuscript.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction: α-β: dT/dPxx = -1.5e-2 K/MPa, dPxx/dH = -1.6e3 MPa/Å, dH/dT = -4.2e-2 Å/K; β-γ: dT/dPxx = 6.5e-2 K/MPa, dPxx/dH = -1.8e3 MPa/Å, dH/dT = 8.5e-3 Å/K.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Exact table entries from the published source.

outputs.description: Raw thermodynamic data from NPxxT MD simulations; checked for first-order phase transition signatures (discontinuous drops in Pzz) on compression.

required.alpha_beta: object with keys dT_dPxx, dPxx_dH, dH_dT
required.beta_gamma: object with keys dT_dPxx, dPxx_dH, dH_dT

outputs.description: Clapeyron slopes for the α→β and β→γ liquid-solid phase boundaries of confined water; the checker compares the reported slopes to hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: The step_02 Clapeyron slopes are scored by reference match against hidden gold values. The step_01 CSV is audited for phase-transition signatures. The NPT solvation force curves are not scored as a separate artifact because the main quantitative reproduction target (phase boundary slopes) is fully captured by the NPxxT system, and scoring the qualitative force curves would require leaking the exact figure values from the paper.
